narration.text: One AI presenter costs over five thousand pounds a year. Ouch!

First up, cost! Synthesia's enterprise focus means a hefty starting price, well over five thousand pounds annually. HeyGen, however, offers a much more accessible entry point, under thirty pounds per month, with flexible plans. No contest here! HeyGen takes this round easily.

Next, customisation! Synthesia excels with custom avatar creation and deep brand integration, perfect for large organisations. HeyGen provides many stock avatars and templates, but its branding options are more basic. Synthesia's superior customisation gives it the edge in this round!
Synthesia is the overall champion for large corporate needs, offering unmatched customisation. HeyGen remains superior for budget-conscious users and quick content creation. Which one would you pick?
